subject: ClearPath pilot: live lab scheduling and runbook owners
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: ClearPath pilot: live lab scheduling and runbook owners

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time on the call Friday. As discussed, we9d like to run a 2.5-hour live lab where we:
- walk through the Redwood runtime and routing rules with your integration
- do a focused prompt review and system prompting workshop (30-45m)
- run two short load tests to validate latency under your peak mix (30m each)

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 9 Nov, 09:00-11:30
- Wed 10 Nov, 13:00-15:30
- Thu 11 Nov, 08:00-10:30

Agenda and a very short runbook attached (ClearPath_POC_Agenda_v2.pdf). Quick asks before we lock a slot:
1) Can you confirm the list of attendees (engineer + product) and whether we should include your SRE for the load window?
2) Do you have a small sample of the production prompt set or a synthetic workload we should load against (we can take a CSV or snapshot)?
3) Any IP/network constraints for joining Zoom (corp VPN, allowlist)?

If those windows are tight we can shift — happy to work around your calendar.

Thanks,
Mateo
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachment: ClearPath_POC_Agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 180KB)
From: Emily Zhang <emily@clearpath.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClearPath pilot: live lab scheduling and runbook owners

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the clear options. We9re eager to run this. A few updates from our side:
- Our SRE (Rajiv Kumar) is only available on Wed afternoon, but he9s on PTO next week except Wed.
- We can provide a 500-row sample of anonymized prompts; I9ll share a link to a secure S3 bucket by EOD Wednesday.
- We have a corporate meeting on Wed 13:00-14:00, so your Wed 13:00-15:30 window will overlap by an hour.

Can we do Thu 11 Nov, 08:00-10:30 PST? If Rajiv can join remotely for the latter half, that9d be ideal.

Also: please include a brief section in the agenda on KV/prefix caching behavior — our team is specifically interested in cache hit strategies for multi-tenant routing.

Cheers,
Emily
Director, Product 
ClearPath AI
emily@clearpath.ai
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: ClearPath pilot: live lab scheduling and runbook owners

Emily —

Thu 11 Nov, 08:00-10:30 PST works for our side; locking that in unless I hear otherwise. We9ll update the agenda to add a 15-minute KV/prefix caching segment during the prompt workshop.

Quick internal notes (cc9d Neha and Karthik):
- Neha: can you own the run of the first load test (we9ll do a warmup + 15-minute steady-state run)? The attached redwood-loadtest-plan.xlsx has the payloads we discussed.
- Karthik: can you own the routing/fallback demo and bring the canary config (we have 10 minutes reserved for failure/fallback simulation).
- Marissa: can you run the post-session recap email and capture owners/time-to-complete?

Emily: please send the prompt sample link when ready. For the load tests, if possible send the expected concurrency profile (rps and burst) or we can mirror your anonymized telemetry.

I9ll schedule the Zoom invite and share the Drive folder.

Thanks,
Mateo

- Mateo: please add the Zoom details and add me as a co-host so I can start the test harness.

- Marissa: draft the recap template and include an owners table (owner, task, ETA).
